scope: Read-only current installed input/result/report handoff investigation; new improvements proposed, not implemented

findings.trigger: A valid init_example(xy-ballistic) recipe2 with only sources[0].configuration.columns changed to null
findings.observed: Exit1 TypeError traceback from set(columns); target absent. Expected structured input error/exit2 is bypassed.
findings.root_cause: Nested external configuration remains Any and is consumed as a mapping before its owner normalizes shape; the CLI exception boundary is not the right place to reinterpret arbitrary TypeError.
findings.proposal: Normalize nested source configuration once at the source-input owner, including columns/units/velocity/filter mappings, and return a small typed configuration or validated mapping with field-path ValueError.
findings.verification: Public CLI and Python malformed-shape cases produce a useful field-path input error and no published case; valid source identity/units/weights remain unchanged.

findings.trigger: Public analyze -o route with one controlled file-write interruption at a new output target
findings.observed: Structured exit2, but a27byte incomplete public JSON remains; the next exclusive-create attempt cannot retry at that target.
findings.root_cause: The CLI single-file report writes directly to the final target, while export/view use staging and completed publication. Completion ownership stops at different output types.
findings.proposal: Stage derived JSON in the destination filesystem and publish exclusively only after serialization and successful write; preserve no-overwrite semantics and remove staging on failure. Keep this a small client publication operation, not a general framework.
findings.verification: One public CLI interrupted-write test leaves no final target, retries successfully, and refuses to overwrite a completed JSON.

findings.trigger: A copy of a valid fresh xy-ballistic result, with only finite final.h5 model_weight doubled
findings.observed: open_result accepts the copy; summarize_result population weight changes1.0 to2.0 while source_identity remains identical.
findings.root_cause: The common identity binds manifest/context and parent inputs; final value bytes are not bound by that identity and final validation checks layouts and selected invariants, not a value hash. Older segment all-value hashing is already a documented separate limit.
findings.proposal: First state logical-run identity and artifact-integrity guarantees separately. If corruption detection is required, output owns a streamed final-artifact hash and its validation/cache at opening; consumers reuse the one opened identity rather than adding separate hashes or validators.
findings.verification: Finite value-only mutations of copied final artifacts are detected when integrity is promised; legitimate moved results and reused cohorts preserve identity; measure extra I/O/hash cost and peak memory.
findings.limit: This controlled modification does not show spontaneous numerical corruption or invalidate normal produced results.

findings.root_cause: Production choices, ordinary tests and report count derive from EXAMPLE_NAMES, but installed acceptance duplicates four names plus implicit ballistic and emits literal five passed.
findings.proposal: Enumerate the installed inventory for completeness, retain explicit analytic example expectations separately, and record exact executed names/count in the acceptance receipt.
findings.verification: Adding/removing one example changes CLI choices, ordinary parametrization, installed completeness and report count together.

already_implemented_boundaries_to_preser: Recipe2 complete table set and one create_case bundle/source authority
Shared core preparation for check/run; four core operations and one engine
Nested immutable ResultView manifest, explicit manifest_document and common source_identity
Reusable ResultCohort preserves exact IDs/count/weight selection
Case/producer/export/view staged completed artifacts and explicit coverage/physical limits

worked_change_examples.change: Remove only the xy-time-field educational example
worked_change_examples.automatic_current_handoffs: CLI choices, scenario parametrization and report example count already derive from EXAMPLE_NAMES.
worked_change_examples.preserve: Core linear-time field interpolation and its independent test_fields.py verification remain supported; removing a teaching example does not remove a physics capability.
worked_change_examples.verification: Remaining examples work through CLI/Python, editable recipe reconstruction and a clean installed wheel; removed example name is rejected.

worked_change_examples.change: Add a force model or an actual new physics category
worked_change_examples.required_work: Own the equation/reference and revision, field SI/value constraints, typed plan, prepare global/local proof and coupling, compiled contribution, analytic/manufactured and refinement evidence. A new state also deliberately changes resident/checkpoint/result projections. No plugin registry is implied.
worked_change_examples.current_good_handoffs: CLI models and report physics rows derive from describe_models; normal producers remain primitive-based and unchanged when their existing field representation suffices.
worked_change_examples.extension_hazard: SUPPORTED_PHYSICS_CATEGORIES derives from descriptors but selected_models assembly is a separate fixed category tuple. In an isolated hypothetical partial-registration probe, a review_force descriptor/category is accepted but omitted from resolved_models and has_force remains false. This is not a currently shipped configuration defect.
worked_change_examples.proposal: Keep the typed fixed contribution order but fail closed when any recognized descriptor is not consumed by the resolved plan. One explicit category/order owner or a narrow exhaustive-consumption check is enough.
worked_change_examples.verification: A partially registered category fails before execution; the completed model has independent equation/units/bound tests and a public case proving a nonzero expected contribution.

limits: No production/source edits for these proposed improvements.
Small public probes and targeted source inspection, not a new full solver/native campaign.
Physical cleanup remains blocked and unexecuted; these analysis findings do not claim the retirement goal complete.
